# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the time of Nell's arrival  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby’s husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed is an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame and hunching shoulders. He has lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders and has kept a thick, gentle brown beard since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is an extremely timid, bashful, and quiet man who despises being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he must converse. He fears women, believing they quietly mock him, with the exception of his sister Thirza and Agatha Sowerby. Despite his quiet demeanor, he can exhibit a stubborn determination when he sets his heart on something. He possesses a gentle, sympathetic nature and suffers from internal distress at the thought of hurting others.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026)_

- Farming and agricultural work  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep Nell at Grey Shutters and provide her a good home  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy lived a quiet life at Grey Shutters with his sister Thirza. Seeking farm assistance due to his advancing age and heart trouble, he and Thirza arranged to adopt a young boy from an orphanage in Nova Scotia. When Obed traveled to Alder River station, he discovered that a girl, Nell Harcourt, had been sent by mistake instead. Unable to leave her behind, he brought her to Grey Shutters and quietly insisted on keeping her despite Thirza's initial objections. Obed quickly formed a deep bond with Nell, enjoying her chatter and often intervening when Thirza was strict. Over the years, he showed Nell great affection, buying her treats and secretly purchasing a stylish dress with puffed sleeves for her Christmas gift. Shortly before Nell was due to attend college, news arrived that the Abbey Bank, where Obed kept all his savings, had failed. The shock caused Obed to collapse and die instantly of a heart attack in his doorway, leaving his family to mourn a kind and gentle man.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P28](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0028), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c6 P33](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0033), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c14 P20](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0020), [v1 c25 P3](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0003), [v1 c25 P33](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0033), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_
